shared_elements: upright slab/stela with carved relief on one face
row of repeated figures across an upper register
horizontal band or line dividing registers
small repeated signs arranged in a row
justification: Both are upright slabs whose upper zone carries a row of repeated figures above a horizontal dividing band, with profile animals/birds and serpentine forms appearing below, which gives a loose registered layout in common. But A is dominated by dense rows of small conventional script signs with seated deities in a shrine-like top register, while B shows large, bold, isolated animal reliefs (birds, quadruped, snake-like body) with no writing and quite different, high-relief schematic conventions.
